definition: Vietnam's direct online visa channel, applied for and approved through the National Immigration Department's own portal, covering tourism and short business trips for up to 90 days.
longform: The e-visa is only valid for entry and exit through a defined list of approved checkpoints, not any airport or land border in the country; a detail that matters more than the application form itself for anyone planning a specific route into or out of Vietnam. It should not be confused with visa-exemption, a separate arrangement that lets certain nationalities enter for a short period without any visa at all.

sources.label: Vietnam National Electronic Visa system, evisa.gov.vn
